trollstigen-geiranger-golden-route.title: Trollstigen · Geiranger Golden Route
trollstigen-geiranger-golden-route.slogan: A 268 km loop out of Åndalsnes
trollstigen-geiranger-golden-route.story: Trollstigen climbs a near-vertical wall with the Stigfossen falls spilling across it, and the viewing platform at the top looks straight back down the stack. Link it with the Geiranger ferry and Ørnesvingen and you have the most photographed day of riding in Norway. Book nothing tightly - the ferries set the pace.

scenicChapters.title: Trollstigen
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 17 km. 848 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Trollstigen
scenicChapters.narrative: 37 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

scenicChapters.title: Geiranger-Trollstigen Norwegian Scenic Route
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 26.1%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter. First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Trollstigen
scenicChapters.narrative: Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace. 848 m come off over 17 km at around 5.5%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Passo di Giau · Dolomites
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2236 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

passo-giau-and-falzarego-loop.story: From Cortina d'Ampezzo it runs 30 km to Cortina d'Ampezzo; allow about 29 min of riding. It goes by way of Passo Giau, Selva di Cadore and Passo Falzarego. The highest point is about 2,250 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
